Visitor skips superscript from output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitSuperscript(NodeContext ctx, String text) {
                return new VisitResult.Skip();
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>The equation x<sup>3</sup> + y<sup>3</sup> = z<sup>3</sup> has no solutions.</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
